mapper.sql: SELECT t.id, t.course_id, t.primary_teacher_id, t.assistant_teacher_id, t.classroom_id, t.total_hours, t.sessions_per_week, t.duration_weeks, t.required_room_type, t.task_batch, t.notes, t.status, t.created_at, t.updated_at, c.id AS course_id2, c.name AS course_name, c.course_type, c.required_room_type AS course_required_room_type, pt.id AS pt_id, pt.name AS pt_name, pt.employee_no AS pt_employee_no, pt.department AS pt_dept, at.id AS at_id, at.name AS at_name, cr.id AS cr_id, cr.name AS cr_name, cr.building AS cr_building, cr.capacity AS cr_capacity, cr.classroom_type AS cr_classroom_type FROM teaching_task t LEFT JOIN course c ON t.course_id = c.id LEFT JOIN teacher pt ON t.primary_teacher_id = pt.id LEFT JOIN teacher at ON t.assistant_teacher_id = at.id LEFT JOIN classroom cr ON t.classroom_id = cr.id
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM teaching_task t LEFT JOIN course c ON t.course_id = c.id LEFT JOIN teacher pt ON t.primary_teacher_id = pt.id LEFT JOIN teacher at ON t.assistant_teacher_id = at.id
ORDER BY t.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
